Container.Name: ATM11-Server
Container.Overview:
All the Mods 11 (ATM11) server for Unraid with automatic updates via CurseForge.
On each container start, the server will check for a new ATM11 release and update automatically before starting. NeoForge is installed or updated as required.
REQUIRED SETTINGS: - CF_API_KEY: Your CurseForge API key (free at console.curseforge.com). Required for automatic updates. - EULA: Must be set to true to accept the Minecraft EULA (aka.ms/MinecraftEULA).
OPTIONAL SETTINGS: - AUTO_UPDATE: Set to false to disable automatic updates on start (default: true). - MEMORY_MAX: Maximum RAM e.g. 8G or 10240M. Recommended minimum 6G (default: 8G). - MEMORY_MIN: Minimum RAM e.g. 4G (default: 4G). - MAX_PLAYERS: Maximum number of players (default: 20). - SERVER_PORT: Server port - must match the port mapping above (default: 25565). - MOTD: Message shown in the server list (default: All the Mods 11). - SEED: World generation seed. Leave blank for random. Only applied before first world creation. - WHITE_LIST: Set to true to enable whitelist (default: false). - WHITELIST: Comma-separated player usernames to whitelist e.g. Player1,Player2. - OPS: Comma-separated player usernames to make operators e.g. Player1,Player2.
FIRST RUN: Expect 10-15 minutes on first start while server files and NeoForge libraries are downloaded. Watch the logs for progress.
DATA: World data, server.properties, ops.json and whitelist.json are never overwritten by updates. Full details at github.com/johnwhite20/atm11-server

Config.Name: Server Data
Config.Description: Path where server files, world data and config are stored.

Config.Name: CurseForge API Key
Config.Description: Your CurseForge API key. Required for automatic updates. Obtain free at https://console.curseforge.com/

Config.Name: Accept EULA
Config.Description: Set to true to accept the Minecraft End User Licence Agreement (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA). Server will not start without this.

Config.Name: Auto Update
Config.Description: Check for and apply ATM11 updates on each container start.

Config.Name: Max RAM
Config.Description: Maximum JVM heap size e.g. 8G or 10240M. Recommended minimum 6G.

Config.Name: Server Port
Config.Description: Minecraft server port (must match the Game Port mapping above).

Config.Name: MOTD
Config.Description: Message of the day shown in the server list.

Config.Name: World Seed
Config.Description: World generation seed. Leave blank for a random seed. Only applied on first start before a world exists.

Config.Name: Operators
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of operator usernames e.g. Player1,Player2

Config.Name: Whitelist
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of whitelisted player usernames.

Config.Name: Enable Whitelist
Config.Description: Set to true to enable the whitelist.
